data_objects.name: intraday_market_bars
data_objects.meaning: Intraday open-high-low-close market bars with trading volume.
data_objects.notes: The traded instrument, trading date, price denomination, and volume unit are not present.

variables.name: Time
variables.meaning: Time-of-day label for the market interval.

variables.name: Volume
variables.meaning: Trading volume recorded for the interval.

structure.description: Each row is an apparent one-minute intraday market interval identified by Time and ordered through the trading session.
Open, High, Low, and Close form the price summary for the same interval; Volume describes activity in that interval.

uncertainties: The instrument, venue, calendar date, time zone, and units are not identified.
It is unclear whether Time marks the start or end of each interval.
annotation_notes: The map preserves market-bar semantics without assigning an asset or currency not present in train.csv.
